tool_input.command:

python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
d = json.load(open("diagnosis.json"))
valid = {"obsolete_assertion", "implementation_defect"}
print("top-level keys:", sorted(d.keys()))
for k in ("native", "external"):
    v = d.get(k)
    print(f"{k}: type={type(v).__name__} value={v!r} valid={isinstance(v,str) and v in valid}")
e = d.get("evidence")
print("evidence is separate top-level object:", isinstance(e, dict))
EOF
